header.caveat: NOT like-for-like vs PaperQA2: PaperQA2 was trained on LitQA2 (train+eval), Munin's model (Qwen3.8-27B) was not. A loss is expected and informative; parity is strong; a win remarkable. Precision excludes abstentions + unparseable; accuracy counts them as wrong.
